documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Outcome Of Board Meeting - Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 Regarding The Proposed Incorporation Of A Wholly Owned Subsidiary

analysis.summary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited published its Investor Presentation for Q2 & H1 FY27. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations grew 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore, while Profit After Tax increased 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore. The company operationalized its Kandivali manufacturing facility, expanding in-house production capacity from 2,500 kg to 4,000 kg per annum. Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore in H1 FY27 compared to -₹412.11 crore in H1 FY26. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported the operationalization of its Kandivali manufacturing facility, expanding its annual installed capacity from 2,500 kg to 4,000 kg.

guidance.claim: The company expects production at its new facility to ramp up in coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: Shringar House remains committed to delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: We remain committed to our guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.

guidance.claim: Management targets a value CAGR in the 30% range over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: Therefore, looking ahead over the next two to three years, our projected CAGR in terms of value is easily achievable within the 30% range.

guidance.claim: The company expects to increase its mangalsutra sales by 33% to 35% within the year.
guidance.quote: Within this year, we will increase our mangalsutra sales by one-third, i.e., approximately 33% to 35%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects store expansion by corporate clientele to generate additional demand for its products.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

demand_outlook.claim: The new factory focuses on innovative designs tailored to diverse customer preferences across India.
demand_outlook.quote: The new factory focuses on innovative, contemporary designs, with newly hired karigars and designers dedicated to creating Mangalsutras & bridal jewellery tailored to diverse customer preferences across India.

demand_outlook.claim: The company relies on outsourced production alongside in-house capacity to meet growing product demand.
demand_outlook.quote: To meet growing demand, the company complements its in-house capacity with outsourced production.

demand_outlook.claim: Shringar achieved a production volume growth of approximately 15% for the year.
demand_outlook.quote: This year as well, if I look at it from a production perspective, we are witnessing a volume growth of approximately 15%.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold jewellery demand is projected to grow alongside an estimated 7% to 8% annual increase in weddings.
demand_outlook.quote: Thus, with the volume of weddings increasing by approximately 7% to 8% annually, the gold jewellery industry is also advancing and expanding at a corresponding pace.

demand_outlook.claim: Sales volume in Q4 FY26 grew by 16% year-on-year to 500 kgs.
demand_outlook.quote: Sales volume for the fourth quarter stood at 500 kgs, up 16% Y-o-Y.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested approximately ₹15 crore from internal accruals to expand capacity and upgrade machinery.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed on February 23, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune.
capex_expansion.quote: Opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune

capex_expansion.claim: The company established a new branch office in Pune to expand its presence across Marathwada and Vidarbha.
capex_expansion.quote: As a part of our ongoing expansion strategy, we successfully inaugurated a new branch office in Pune, a move that has significantly enhanced our geographic footprint in Western India from Marathwada to Vidarbha regions.

capex_expansion.claim: Shringar expanded its fourth-quarter manufacturing capacity from 2,500 kgs to 4,000 kgs.
capex_expansion.quote: Firstly, we executed a major expansion of our manufacturing capabilities during the fourth quarter, resulting in a meaningful increase in production capacity from 2,500 kgs to 4,000 kgs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its product offerings by entering the bridal jewellery market.
capex_expansion.quote: Secondly, we made a strategic entry into the bridal jewellery segment, which represents a natural extension to our core mangalsutra business.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations grew 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27 from ₹861.41 crore in H1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore with a PAT margin of 5.37% in H1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin expanded by 65 basis points year-on-year to 8.9% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit margin stood at 8.9%, expanded by 65 basis points over year-to-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 declined by 41 basis points year-on-year to 6.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin were at 6.2%, down by 41 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Full-year FY26 EBITDA margin improved by 61 basis points to 7.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin was at 7.1%, up by 61 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in Q4 other expenses was predominantly driven by notional hedging losses.
margins_costs.quote: The biggest difference, if any, is the hedging notional loss.

orders_capacity.claim: The new capacity was added in February 2026, bringing full-year blended capacity to 2,625 kgs with 87% actual capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: The new capacity was added in February 2026. Blended capacity for full year is 2625 kgs. Hence, actual capacity utilization is 87%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates an integrated manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of 4,000 kg.
orders_capacity.quote: 4,000 kg p.a Capacity in an integrated manufacturing facility

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved an 87% effective capacity utilization rate for FY26 on a blended capacity of 2,625 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: As a result, the blended capacity for the year stood at 2,625 kgs, leading to an effective capacity utilization of 87% for FY '26.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed manufacturing capacity is 4,000 kgs for the next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: For the next financial year, our available installed capacity stays at 4,000 kgs, and we expect to further ramp up production in the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Shringar serves 1,333 clients globally and across India for its mangalsutra product line.
orders_capacity.quote: For mangalsutra, we have 1,333 clients all over India and the world.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, helped by lower working capital outflow.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, supported by lower working capital outflow.

capital_allocation.claim: Operations require significant working capital and liquidity to support multi-location business expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: Our operations are working capital intensive, requiring adequate liquidity and funds to support business expansion and diversification across multiple locations

capital_allocation.claim: The company's debt-to-equity ratio stood at 0.27 for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt-equity ratio for financial '26 remained at 0.27.

risks_headwinds.claim: The latest gold import duty increase to 15% was directly absorbed into market prices of gold.
risks_headwinds.quote: This latest increase was directly absorbed into gold prices, pushing prices higher.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold hedging activities result in a notional loss when MCX gold prices increase.
risks_headwinds.quote: Since we hedge gold, it results in a notional loss because if we have hedged the gold at whatever price we have bought it at in MCX, whatever additional payment we have to make due to increase in the price of gold, that actually results in loss.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects production to ramp up at the expanded facility in coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: Shringar House commits to delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to our guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects available installed manufacturing capacity to remain at 4,000 kgs in the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: For the next financial year, our available installed capacity stays at 4,000 kgs, and we expect to further ramp up production in the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to increase mangalsutra sales by approximately 33% to 35% within the current year.
management_commitments.quote: Within this year, we will increase our mangalsutra sales by one-third, i.e., approximately 33% to 35%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
